notes.title: Celebrate the Lost Records Release with DON’T NOD Discounts!
notes.notes:
Tape 1 of DON’T NOD’s upcoming narrative adventure game, Lost Records: Bloom & Rage, officially releases on February 18! To celebrate, we wanted to spread the love, and what better way than to throw a little release party in the form of big discounts on our other published games?  

Check out the sale here! 

From now til February 28, we’re having one big narrative-rich story game bonanza. You can grab Twin Mirror, Jusant, Harmony: The Fall of Reverie (on sale from Feb 17), and Gerda: A Flame in Winter, all at huge discounts of up to 80%.
